name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Rear Delt Row (Incline Bench)
instructions: Set an adjustable bench to a low incline and lie face down with your chest supported on the pad, a dumbbell in each hand.
Let the arms hang straight down with palms facing each other and elbows slightly bent.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides until the elbows reach shoulder height, squeezing the rear delts and upper back.
Lower under control and repeat. Keep your chest on the bench the whole time.
